# Vent Busters

> Vent Busters is a dryer vent cleaning specialist serving homeowners across Palm Beach County and the Treasure Coast, from Boca Raton to Port St. Lucie. Dryer vents are the only thing the company works on: cleaning, blockage removal, roof vents, repairs, replacement, reconnection, transition hoses, booster fans and airflow testing.

## Company Facts
- Name: Vent Busters
- Phone: (561) 884-4648
- Email: Ventsbusters@gmail.com
- Website: https://www.vent-busters.com/
- Specialty: Dryer vents only. Vent Busters does NOT do air duct cleaning, HVAC duct cleaning, UV light systems, HVAC sanitization, mold assessment or mold remediation. These were previously offered and were discontinued.
- Google Business Profile category: Dryer vent cleaning service
- Service area: Palm Beach County & the Treasure Coast — Boca Raton to Port St. Lucie (20 communities). Service-area business; no separate offices in these cities.
- Hours: Monday–Thursday 7am–6pm, Friday 7am–3pm; closed Saturday and Sunday
- Pricing: No published flat rate — quoted after an evaluation, explained before work begins
- Credentials: Insured. Vent Busters does not claim any contractor license or certification; dryer vent cleaning is not a licensed trade in Florida.
- Guarantee: Not satisfied? Tell us within 14 days and we'll re-clean the accessible components at no charge, or refund that service.
- Reviews: 5.0 from 3 reviews on Google (https://www.google.com/maps?cid=2546061381231444699). Every review shown on the site is reproduced verbatim from that listing.

## Services
- [Dryer Vent Cleaning](https://www.vent-busters.com/dryer-vent-cleaning.html): Rotary brush and vacuum cleaning of the accessible dryer vent pathway, with airflow checked before and after.
- [Clogged Dryer Vent](https://www.vent-busters.com/clogged-dryer-vent.html): Two cycles to dry, a hot laundry room, or no air at the outside hood.
- [Dryer Vent Blockage Removal](https://www.vent-busters.com/dryer-vent-blockage-removal.html): Dryer vent severely restricted or fully blocked?
- [Roof Dryer Vent Cleaning](https://www.vent-busters.com/roof-dryer-vent-cleaning.html): Interior and upstairs laundry rooms vent through the attic to a roof cap.
- [Dryer Vent Repair](https://www.vent-busters.com/dryer-vent-repair.html): Crushed pipe, separated joints, leaking seams and flaps that will not swing.
- [Dryer Vent Replacement](https://www.vent-busters.com/dryer-vent-replacement.html): Dryer vent replacement in Palm Beach County.
- [Dryer Vent Reconnection](https://www.vent-busters.com/dryer-vent-reconnection.html): Duct that has separated in an attic or wall vents hot, damp air into the structure.
- [Dryer Transition Hose Replacement](https://www.vent-busters.com/dryer-transition-hose-replacement.html): The short connector behind your dryer is the most crushed part of the system.
- [Dryer Booster Fan Service](https://www.vent-busters.com/dryer-booster-fan-service.html): Long duct runs sometimes rely on an in-line booster fan, and a lint-loaded fan quietly stops helping.
- [Dryer Vent Airflow Testing](https://www.vent-busters.com/dryer-vent-airflow-testing.html): A free measured airflow reading, a visual check of the accessible components, and a written report.

## Common Questions
- How much does dryer vent cleaning cost? No published flat rate. It depends on the length of the run, the number of turns, how the termination is accessed and what is found inside. Quoted before work begins.
- How often should a dryer vent be cleaned in Florida? Usage matters more than the calendar. Many South Florida homes land near once a year; long roof-vented runs sooner. Humidity makes lint mat together rather than stay loose.
- Does Vent Busters clean air ducts or HVAC systems? No. Dryer vents only. Air duct and HVAC work should go to an HVAC contractor.
- Does Vent Busters do mold assessment or remediation? No. If material that may require assessment is observed, evaluation by an appropriately licensed professional is recommended.
- Is Vent Busters licensed or certified? No such claim is made. Dryer vent cleaning is not a licensed trade in Florida. Vent Busters is insured.
- Does cleaning a dryer vent prevent fires? No service can honestly promise that. Cleaning removes the lint fuel and restores airflow. Failure to clean was the leading factor in home clothes-dryer fires analysed by the U.S. Fire Administration.
- Do you offer same-day service? Same-day and next-day appointments are often available, depending on technician availability and location.
- What proof is given that the work changed anything? Airflow is measured at the termination before and after on every job, with before-and-after photos where conditions allow.
- What areas do you serve? The 20 communities listed below, from Boca Raton to Port St. Lucie.
